title: Pacing sentinel and soft eviction fence for regional surges
author: Marisol Vega
commits: a1f4b9c: introduce pacing sentinel core loop and state machine
b2d5e7f: wire telemetry egress anchors into control plane and expose metrics
c3e6f8a: add unit + integration tests, docs and helm toggles
d4f7a90: address lint/format failures and tweak thresholds after bench runs
description: Context: Production incidents in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 showed fast cross-region evictions during short egress saturation bursts. The SLO enforcer responded by aggressively evicting tenants, which amplified load and extended recovery windows. This PR introduces the 'pacing sentinel' — a small runtime controller that makes eviction decisions with an additional telemetry-anchored soft eviction fence and a sticky probe mechanism to avoid cascade eviction during transient egress spikes. Motivation: reduce tenant churn during short-lived regional surges while preserving SLO enforcement guarantees. Key behaviors: 1) Telemetry anchoring: the sentinel consumes recent egress and latency quantiles and computes a confidence-weighted egress pressure score. 2) Soft eviction fence: when egress pressure is near threshold, instead of immediate eviction, the sentinel applies a soft fence that reduces new admission tokens for lower-priority tenants (pacing tokens) and delays hard eviction by a short, bounded window. 3) Sticky probe: once a tenant is soft-fenced, a periodic sticky probe (single-request probe) checks if the tenant can be restored without causing oscillation; probes are rate-limited and randomized to avoid synchronized restarts. 4) Gradual restore: when pressure subsides, tokens are restored incrementally with a warmup period to avoid immediate re-surge. Files touched: runtime eviction state machine (pacing_sentinel.go), telemetry anchor (egress_anchor.go), SLO enforcer integration (enforcer.go), helm toggle and values, tests, docs, and console UI for observability. Checklist: - [x] Design doc: docs/architecture/pacing-sentinel.md - [x] Unit tests: tests/slo/pacing_sentinel_test.go (coverage for fence decisions, probe timing, restore path) - [x] Integration tests: local canary run in us-west-2 simulating egress spikes - [x] Console metrics/alerts wired: web/console/alerts/pacing-sentinel-ui.tsx - [x] Helm flag: deploy/helm/values-eviction.yaml (feature gated) - [x] Backwards compatible: integrates with existing enforcer without schema changes. Rollout plan: 1) Merge behind helm feature flag off by default. 2) Enable in us-west-2 for 10% of traffic (canary) for 24h while monitoring these metrics: egress_pressure_score (p50/p95), eviction_rate_by_tenant, soft_fence_rate, restore_success_ratio. 3) If canary is stable (<5% change in end-to-end tail latency and eviction_rate decreases), expand to region. 4) Global rollout only after two full days of regional stability. Observability and alerts: added pacing_sentinel.fence_applied, pacing_sentinel.probe_failures, pacing_sentinel.restore_rate. Alert thresholds included in docs. CI: initial CI run failed on lint/format; fixed in final commit d4f7a90. Final CI: all unit tests pass and integration harness completes in simulated canary mode. Review summary: Jin Park: requested clearer bounds on probe frequency and token decay; added deterministic rate limiter and updated tests. Noah Patel: asked for telemetry smoothing window to avoid reacting to single outlier spike; implemented EWMA smoothing with configurable alpha. Sandra Li: requested canary rollout recipe and runbook addition; added runbook steps and rollback procedure to docs/architecture/pacing-sentinel.md. Merge notes: Squash merge to preserve a single logical change. Backout plan: helm toggle off; sentinel is stateless and leaves existing eviction logic untouched when feature flag is off. Risks and mitigations: Risk of increased tail latency if probes cause sudden burst — mitigated by randomized probe jitter and strict probe rate limits. Risk of under-eviction leaving system overloaded — we keep hard-ejection fallback after soft-fence window expiry and also expose emergency override via SRE console. Release notes: "Introduce pacing sentinel: a telemetry-driven soft eviction fence and sticky probe to reduce cascade evictions during short regional egress surges. Can be enabled via helm feature flag. Adds new metrics and alerts for monitoring." Merge method: squash and merge.
